Ironsworn

A tabletop roleplaying game by Shawn Tomkin set in the mythic dark fantasy world of the Ironlands. Players take on the role of Ironsworn, heroes bound to sworn vows who face peril, make allies, and explore a dangerous frontier. Ironsworn plays solo, cooperatively, or with a guide (GM).

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Attribution: Ironsworn System Reference Document, copyright Shawn Tomkin. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. SRD source: TedTschopp/Ironsworn-SRD, Ironsworn SRD.md.

Core Mechanics

  • Moves — How to resolve actions using Action Dice vs Challenge Dice
  • Stats and Tracks — Edge, Heart, Iron, Shadow, Wits; Health, Spirit, Supply, Momentum
  • Vows — Swearing iron vows, progress tracks, reaching your vow
  • Combat — Enter the Fray, Strike, Clash, End the Fight
  • Journeys — Undertake a Journey, Make Camp, Reach Your Destination
  • Delving — Enter the Darkness, Delve the Depths, Find an Opportunity
  • The World — The Ironlands, regions, threats, and lore
  • Assets — Companions, paths, combat talents, rituals
  • Oracles — How to use oracle tables for inspiration and randomness

Oracle Tables

Oracle tables provide randomised narrative inspiration. Roll dice and consult the relevant table for an unexpected result that drives the story. Machine-readable oracle tables are in the oracles/ directory.

  • Oracle Index — All 13 oracle tables with usage notes
